notes:
ThunderAlley 3.20.0: smoother frame rates
- Simplified buildings and vehicles in the distance: past a distance set by your graphics preset, each building and vehicle is drawn as one simplified piece in its own colours instead of its many separate parts (walls, floors, windows, roof, trim, hull, wheels). Up close nothing changes, and a building that has been blown open always shows its real damage. Turrets, guns and rotors still move at any distance.
- Buildings now hide what's behind them: the game skips drawing things that are completely blocked from view by a building's walls (you still see through doors, windows and holes).
- Props are drawn together: sandbags, barriers, hesco walls, barrels, tyres, crates, rocks and trees that use the same model are drawn as one batch per patch of ground instead of one by one.
- Building insides (floor tiles, stairs and railings) are no longer drawn from far away.
- Idle smoke, dust and spark effects no longer cost anything while they're not playing.
- In testing on Medium, the busiest views on Kessel went from about 1,400 to about 600-650 things drawn per frame (less than half); Intel Wars from about 780-1,010 to 600-830.
- New "Auto-adjust quality" setting (on by default): if your phone can't keep up with the graphics preset, the game steps it down one level during the match and tells you. It changes at most twice a match. Turn it off in Settings > Graphics to keep your own choice.
